target_label: Provide an IDE-deportable patch application matrix and bundle so ChatGPT session plans can be transported to Git via canonical .patch files.
master_target_label: Make ChatGPT conversation sessions produce canonical GitHub patches that IDE can apply through a stable matrix without reconstructing the plan.
target_completion_criteria: Patch is deposited at repo root as temporary inbox
No root-level .patch is staged or committed
Diff is conformant or blockers are documented

after_target_reached.decision_rule: If the bundle is used successfully on a real patch and the session-to-IDE patch chain becomes stable, consider master target reached or propose a next bundle for hardening.

global_index_rule: Do not update global indexes for this internal target alone. Propose a global index batch only if the master target or horizon changes.
